network-emissions/1.formula: sum over t of w_generators[t] x p[t] / efficiency[t] x co2_emissions(carrier), summed over all generators
network-emissions/1.validity: verified solve (else unverified_solve); per snapshot p, efficiency and weight finite, efficiency > 0, weight >= 0, else invalid_or_missing_emissions_data; a fuel-curve generator with CO2 gives fuel_curve_generator. Refusals: emissions_outside_scope, misaligned_source, network_scope_required, unknown_generator, unsupported_generator_population, unsupported_snapshot_scope
verified solve and exactly one CO2 cap with a dual (else no_co2_cap, several_co2_caps or unverified_solve / invalid_or_missing_emissions_data)
